mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( order_id, review_content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{reviewContent}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM review ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
